metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for MySQL JDBC driver coordinate migration (mysql:mysql-connector-java → com.mysql:mysql-connector-j) during Spring Boot 3.0 upgrade. No existing skill covers this specific dependency update pattern. Peer candidates address Hibernate, Redis, and Ehcache migrations—different dependencies with different coordinate/property update mechanics. Existing skills are unrelated (JSON parsing, Next.js prefetching). Supported by Spring Boot 3.0 Migration Guide evidence.
